model_transfer.input: Two contexts, 500 candidates; original and migrated implementations in separate processes; single-thread RF accumulation.

submission_protection.inventory: All file names, sizes and modification timestamps equal; text/config/README SHA256 equal. Large weights not reread.

installation: Separate venv, editable install --no-deps --no-build-isolation of an independent copy. Libraries reused from existing environments; original editable source paths excluded.

levels.A: Checked key aggregates, bootstrap, full-model/H5 audits; historical tables without user evidence remain source summaries.
levels.B: 100 head checkpoints and 12 reward models; 112 identical fixed-input outputs before/after migration; 6 masked heads. Full actor inference not run.
levels.C: Stage dependency listing, all-stage dry-run, CLI/import checks, CPU synthetic preparation/actor/head/evaluation. No new Yambda training.

external_requirements: large policy caches or their regeneration
known_limits: Historical panels are previously opened, not independent holdouts.
Remaining external data/cache hashes are inherited or explicitly null; every included checkpoint was hashed for publication.

bundle_verification.note: Final .gitattributes byte-preservation rule separately rehashed after the complete bundle verification.
